sources.snippet: AI infrastructure that developers love. Library / Google / Gemma 4 26B A4B IT Gemma 4 26B A4B IT Gemma 4 26B A4B is the Mixture-of-Experts model in Google DeepMind's Gemma 4 family: 25.2 billion total parameters with only 3.8B active per token, native text and image input, a 256K-token context window, configurable thinking and function calling, released as open weights under Apache 2.0.
